Track 5 follow-up to simdesign-gaugerestart. The two gauge-2 mass groups differ in web width w (about 14.3–14.9 vs 15.2–15.6 mm), not in r. A coarse grid shows one feasible component, but a 0.1 mm w scan shows ragged, isolated feasible pockets below a contiguous region. The lighter group matches those pockets. Stylised and preliminary; the mesh-artefact mechanism is untested. 5 tests pass and `python site/build.py` prints ok.
